sources.title: Counterfactual Multi-Agent Policy Gradients
sources.finding: Uses a centralized critic and a counterfactual baseline marginalizing one agent action while keeping other agents actions fixed.
sources.connection: Alternative-action comparison motivates examining the credit assigned to a choice. Our 2048 host directly computes deterministic immediate gains of legal moves on the actual board.

sources.title: RUDDER: Return Decomposition for Delayed Rewards
sources.finding: Proposes reward redistribution and return decomposition for learning with delayed rewards.
sources.connection: The fifth pass compares uniform terminal reward against decision-specific host feedback on executed code branches.

design: These sources informed the questions. Netta mechanisms and comparison protocols are specified independently in the local source and experiment receipts.
